dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of dark, low-intensity solid blobs is present along the lateral transition line. Scattered high-intensity white flecks are visible on the head and around the posterior flippers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. A series of four dark blobs form a sub-linear arrangement along the lower boundary of the primary texture field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, elongated yellowish-brown linear feature is visible on the mid-ventral-lateral surface, consistent with external debris. Small reddish-brown punctate marks are visible on the posterior-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, irregular boundary separates the patterned dorsal-lateral region from the solid dark-toned posterior and ventral regions.
